question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Amnesty'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arvind Adiga.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amnesty is a novel written by Aravind Adiga.**
 
• It tells the story of a Sri Lankan migrant in Sydney who agonizes over whether to tell the police about a murder and risk deportation.
 
• Amnesty tells the story of Danny, a Sri Lankan who has become an** "illegal alien"** after dropping out of his **"ripoff"** college.
 
• Adiga's debut novel, **The White Tiger, won the 2008 Booker Prize and has been adapted into a Netflix original movie The White Tiger.**
 
• Other books written by him are: Between **the Assassinations, Last Man in Tower, and Selection Day.​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amish Tripathi:**

 
 
• He has written a series based on Ramayana, the first two books focus on Rama and Sita.
 
• The third character of the Ram Chandra series after Rama and Sita is Raavana.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor:**
 
 
• The famous author Shashi Tharoor was awarded Commonwealth Writers Prize for "The Great Indian Novel". Commonwealth Writers Prize was established in 1987.
 
• Other famous books written by Shashi Tharoor are Show Business.
 
• India: From Midnight to Millennium.
